guard: the agent page opens and closes the agent's work in pairs, says every Work state in the mock's words, keeps the plane note out of Work, writes its tab into the route, lists the agent's own verified posts and direct messages in Messages, says in Profile whether it publishes work events, animates only steps that arrive live after mount, keeps a reader at the message they arrived at, rewrites an old link in place, and goes back where the reader came from
why: This suite runs `tsx` directly over `client/src`, with no build step and no compiled second copy, so no `afterRestore` is needed on any mutation here.
